payload.posture: Read Acts 13:44–52 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a city divides around the word. The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God. The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
